name: core.openwop.workflows.kicktodo-research
description: KickTodo research spine as an RFC 0013 chain pack (migrated from the deprecated ADR 0072 builtin `openwop-app.kicktodo.research`, ADR 0472 Phase 2). Frame deterministic research questions, search the web (honestly demo or live per the host adapter), normalize to canonical source records, and build a structure-checked evidence graph. Conversion tightened the builtin's implicit ordering into EXPLICIT edge dataflow (the audit's honesty note): search's `{results,engine}` flows to normalize, normalize's sources flow to the evidence graph.
